scope: Independent pre-outcome statistical design and CPU planning calculations

primary.eligible_runs: two sham-feedback runs, identifiers require raw audit
primary.estimand: equal-participant mean Broad EEGNet mean-rank minus mean-loss balanced accuracy, averaged within participant over three final seeds

secondary_confirmatory_family.gate: primary H1 rejected at two-sided alpha 0.05

design.shared_fixed_broad_fixed_interpretation: matched-duration complete-pipeline contrast; not isolated sharing mechanism

participant_bootstrap.resampling_unit: paired participant difference after seed averaging

class_dominance.participant_rule: mean over seeds of max(predicted class count)/valid predictions >= 0.95
class_dominance.status: descriptive engineering sentinel, not validated clinical or physiological marker

power.method: two-sided noncentral paired t under Gaussian independent participant differences
power.independent_check: normal/chi-square mixture quadrature at five planning points, including n85

unresolved_execution_requirements: Dreyer raw/event/channel/sham-run audit and prior exposure/identity audit
final eligible participant inventory locked before predictions
public committed final protocol/config/runtime binding before neural fitting
model implementation audit and source-only code replay
scientific_limits: Power assumptions are planning scenarios rather than target estimates
The primary cohort size remains nominal until eligibility audit
Inference is conditional on the frozen nine-person source models
Three final seeds, two sessions and individual EEG trials are not independent participants
Single source-CV seed does not establish selection stability across training randomness
Historical targets cannot establish blind independent confirmation
Matched epochs do not remove filtering, views, capacity, BatchNorm or compute differences
review_scope_update: Statistics design/planning and invented-input software only; fresh traditional CSP source fits are recorded separately, not zeroed or counted as target confirmation.
new_eeg_model_fits_field_scope: Zero fits initiated by statistics design/software review; this is not the global experiment counter.
